title: Exact Chained-Word Threshold and Monotone-Path Structure in the Even Root-of-Unity Kaleidoscope Yang-Baxter Algebra
summary: Qiu, Guan, and Yu conjectured that in the even-order Kaleidoscope Yang--Baxter equation every word $ΛT^{k_1}Λ\cdots T^{k_M}Λ$, built from a square-zero matrix $Λ$ and integer powers of a shift $T$ of order $N$, vanishes once $M\geq N/2$. We prove this for every even $N\geq4$ and every complex parameter $u$ with $u\neq0$ and $u^N\neq1$, and show that the bound is sharp. For $M=N/2-1$ we determine exactly which words are nonzero; each of them has rank two. After block reduction, the factors associated with the intervening powers of $T$ lower a common flag of length $N/2$ by at least one step.…
